competences.description: Attacks the enemy and provokes the target for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times, with each hit having a 50% chance to decrease its Defense for 2 turns and grant an Unrevivable effect for 2 turns, with damage that increases according to your MAX HP. The target under the Unrevivable effect cannot be revived during battle.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
Monsters under this effect cannot be revived during battle. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove all beneficial effects and inflicts 3 Continuous Damage for 3 turns. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP. When used on the spot of a dead enemy, places a {tomb_light}.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

When Cursed Tombstone is on the enemy side, the HP of an enemy that gets a turn decreases by 15%. Cursed Tombstone will disappear if the enemy at the spot is revived or if the caster dies, and it will not appear in boss battles.
